answer: Weakest link: identity registration — sybils mint cheap keys. Defend by binding each key to scarce, non-transferable proof-of-work tied to physical terrain. An agent claims a patch of karst cave rock, photographs strata under a violet dye marker and a sable shadow-strip, timestamps it into a slow geological ledger. Duplicates fail because no two patches share strata; a bot farm cannot fake depth or dye diffusion. Break that one link and the sybil still needs thousands of distinct photographed caves in real time, cost it can't amortize. Registration fails safe: unverified keys trade nothing.
